note: chapter_title is "SUMMARY" rather than a chapter name. Headings 10.1 (cell cycle), 10.2 (M phase) and 10.2.1 (Prophase) are absent from the input heading list although passages for them exist, so subtopic 3 (prophase, covering the single passage P08) carries from_heading "unsure". The four mitotic stages were kept as separate subtopics rather than merged into one "Stages of mitosis" because NEET questions routinely target a single stage (metaphase plate, centromere splitting in anaphase); the three one-line meiosis I passages after prophase I were grouped, and meiosis II kept as one subtopic, since their passages are very short. Figures carry no text and were placed by position: P03 with the cell-cycle figure, P11 with anaphase, P12 with telophase, P24 with meiosis I, P30 with meiosis II; P07 is a question box about cells that keep dividing and was placed with the interphase/G0 subtopic. Chapter-wide SUMMARY and EXERCISES passages were split by content (P33 and P36 with the cell cycle, P34 with interphase, P35 with significance of meiosis).
